tasks.short: Prepare correspondence, reports and recommendations for action.

steps.what: Assemble notes from inspections or investigations.
Draft correspondence and reports of inspections.

loop.input: The note bundle the inspector assembled
loop.output: Correspondence and a report that cites only those notes
loop.check: Each sentence must name a note in the bundle, or it is deleted
loop.stop: One draft; a sentence with no note is removed, not rewritten unseen
loop.why_not_simpler: A stored template cannot follow this inspection's notes

steps.what: Write recommendations for action from accepted findings.
Review the report before it can be sent.
Send the accepted correspondence and reports.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store holds the notes. A draft report may use only those notes, and the inspector writes the recommendation. The inspection supervisor accepts one version, and only that version is sent. Native templates in {DOCS} are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports were rewritten from notebooks, and a sentence could not be traced to a note.
tasks.enabler_now: The draft can follow notes. Choosing the action, and anything the notes do not say, stays with the inspector.
tasks.still_hard: Findings that are not in the notes, and recommendations the template has never carried.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector knows which finding is strong enough to recommend an action.

ambition.what: The inspector decides the same day whether the notes are complete enough to support a recommendation.

tasks.altitude: Report writing stays on the week. The inspector can refuse to send a sentence that has no note.

reach.task: Prepare a report of an inspection
reach.learn: Which sentence they refuse until it names the note it came from

evidence.claim: A draft can be limited to notes a person assembled. Text with no source note is not a finding, and the person who owns the finding signs the report.
Sending a report that recommends action against someone is an external act. A person accepts the version before it goes.

assumptions: Focal role is the property inspector. Boundary: from accepted notes to a sent report. The site visit and the investigation are other tasks.

Structured fields are case id, note id, finding id and addressee. The inspector produces the notes. Fallback: a note that is not in the bundle is typed by the inspector, and the draft may not invent it.
Test native templates in {DOCS} before custom code. The US task is read as a European public authority. This task does not monitor staff.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the report template and the note fields.
unknowns: Whether supervisors already accept every report, or only reports that recommend action.
Which case system holds the notes today.
research_questions: What share of a report is a sentence that the notes do not already contain?

already_counted.description: Edit the draft against the notes

incremental.description: Keep the report template and note fields current

approvals.approved_version: report version the supervisor marked accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the notes are incomplete, so the inspector writes the report and the recommendation by hand. High: a standard report drafts from complete notes and the inspector still writes the recommendation. The recommendation is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Examine records and documents to establish facts or detect discrepancies.

steps.what: List the records, reports and other documents.
Match structured figures across those records.
Judge discrepancies the matched figures do not explain.
Write the facts the records establish.
Ask the holder to examine a missing document.

tasks.design: Structured figures in the {ERP} are matched on the case id, amount and date. A workbook is only the glue until that match exists. The inspector judges a discrepancy the figures do not explain, writes the facts, and asks the holder when a document is missing. Native matching in the {ERP} is tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: Figures were copied into a workbook, and a mismatch could be a typing error or a real gap.
tasks.enabler_now: Matching known fields is a rule. Deciding what an unexplained gap means still needs the inspector and, often, the holder.
tasks.still_hard: Documents that are not in the case file, and figures with no agreed field.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector knows when a mismatch is a missing document rather than a wrong total.

ambition.what: The inspector decides the same day which discrepancy is large enough to ask the holder about.

tasks.altitude: Examining files stays on the week. The inspector can refuse to treat a matched total as the fact.

reach.role: Tax Examiners and Collectors, and Revenue Agents
reach.task: Examine records to detect a discrepancy
reach.learn: How they separate a figure mismatch from a missing document

evidence.claim: A records screen can list figures the inspector already entered and mark where two fields disagree. It cannot decide what the disagreement means.

assumptions: Focal role is the property inspector. Boundary: from a document list to established facts or a question to the holder. The inspection itself is another task.

Structured fields are case id, document id, amount, date and party. The record holder produces the source document. The inspector produces the fact. Fallback: an unlisted document is read by the inspector, not extracted.
Test native matching in the {ERP} before custom code. The US task is read as a European public authority. This task does not monitor staff.
Upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the field list used in the match.
unknowns: Which records are structured today, and which still arrive as unstructured documents.
Who is allowed to change a posted figure.
research_questions: What share of discrepancies is a missing document rather than a wrong total?

incremental.description: Keep the figure fields used in the match current

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: most documents are unstructured, so the inspector reads them and the match barely runs. High: the figures are already structured and only unexplained gaps stay with the inspector. The judgement is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect government property on sites for contract and legal compliance.

steps.what: Read contract specifications and legal requirements.
Inspect government property on construction sites or public housing.
Record measurements taken on the site.
Compare entered measurements with numeric specifications.
Decide compliance with the contract and legal requirements.

tasks.design: Before the visit the inspector reads the contract in {CLM}. On site they inspect and record measurements. Numeric lines can be compared with the specification. The compliance decision stays with the inspector, because a comparison is not a finding. Native specification fields are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specifications were carried on paper, and the pass or fail was written up after the inspector had left the site.
tasks.enabler_now: The visit and the decision stay. Only a numeric line that the inspector has entered can be compared.
tasks.still_hard: Conditions the specification does not describe, and requirements that are not a number.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector sees whether the work on site matches the specification, including what a number cannot show.
tasks.altitude: Site days stay on the week. Nothing moves the compliance decision off the inspector.

reach.task: Inspect a site against a permit condition
reach.learn: Which measurement they still take themselves

evidence.claim: A records screen can list contract lines against measurements the inspector entered. It cannot decide compliance.

assumptions: Focal role is the property inspector. Boundary: one site visit against one contract. Writing the later report is another task.

Structured fields are contract line, unit, required value and measured value. The contract produces the required value. The inspector produces the measured value. Fallback: a line with no number is left blank and decided on site.
Test native contract fields in {CLM} before custom code. The US task is read as a European public authority. This task does not monitor staff.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers specification lines.
unknowns: Which contracts already store specification lines as fields.
Whether public housing and construction sites use the same checklist.
research_questions: What share of a visit is a measurement a specification line can hold?

incremental.description: Keep specification lines current when contracts change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the specification is not in fields, so the visit and the write-up stay as they are. High: numeric lines compare themselves and the inspector still walks the site and decides. The visit is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate alleged license or permit violations.

steps.what: Read the alleged license or permit violations.
Open the prior license and permit file.
Investigate the alleged violations with the holder.
Judge whether the facts support the violations.
Draft the finding from notes the inspector accepted.

loop.input: Interview notes and the support judgement
loop.output: A notice that states only those notes and that judgement
loop.check: The inspector deletes any sentence that is not in the notes
loop.stop: One draft; if the judgement is not recorded, no draft is made
loop.why_not_simpler: The notice has to follow this allegation, not a generic violation letter

steps.what: Accept or return the official notice.
Send the official notice of the violations.

tasks.design: The prior license file is opened from {WORKFLOW}. The inspector interviews the holder and judges whether the facts support the violations. A draft notice may use only accepted notes. The supervisor accepts one version before it is sent. Native case fields are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: The allegation, the old file and the interview lived in different places, so the notice was typed from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: Opening the file and drafting from notes can change. The interview and the judgement of support cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Holders who will not speak, and allegations the file does not identify.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector hears what the holder says and decides whether it supports the allegation.
tasks.altitude: Interviews stay on the week. The inspector can stop a notice that goes beyond the notes.

reach.learn: How they keep the allegation separate from the decision

evidence.claim: A case screen can open the prior license file and draft from notes a person accepted. It cannot decide that a violation is proved.
A notice that alleges a violation has a legal effect. A person accepts the version before it is sent. A checklist is not that decision.

assumptions: Focal role is the property inspector. Boundary: from an allegation to a sent notice. Prosecution is another task.

Structured fields are allegation id, license id, holder and note id. The complainant produces the allegation. The inspector produces the interview notes. Fallback: a file that will not open is read from the document store.
Test native case fields in {WORKFLOW} before custom code. The US task is read as a European public authority. This task does not monitor staff.
Upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers allegation types and notice templates.
unknowns: Who may sign a notice today, the inspector or the supervisor.
The exact national rule for notice and time limits.
research_questions: What share of allegations is resolved by the file without an interview?

incremental.description: Keep allegation types and notice templates current

approvals.approved_version: notice version the supervisor marked accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the holder must be interviewed and the file is thin, so almost all the time stays manual. High: the file opens itself and the notice drafts from notes, while the interview and the judgement of support remain. The notice is not sent unaccepted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still sites, products, hearings and files. The inspector can stop a report, a disclosure or a sample submission that is not tied to a note they accepted.
reach: Environmental compliance inspectors: which site measurement they will not take from a photograph
Regulatory affairs specialists: which missing field stops a file
Claims adjusters, examiners, and investigators: how a finding stays tied to a note
skills_to_grow: Refusing a draft sentence that has no source note
Reading a checklist without treating it as a permit decision
Keeping a disclosure inside facts already accepted
role.ambitious_version: Every finding the inspector signs can be traced to a note they accepted, and no permit is granted by a checklist.
